# A call's own @error, run rather than read, on the three runners the golden
# (testdata/call_error_handler.txtar) does not execute: the interpreter, gtk4,
# and html in a real Chromium. The golden's record runs the same program's tests
# on bubbletea, fyne and android.
#
# One test clicks all four buttons because the html agent shares one state
# object across a session, so four tests would each see the ones before it.
# The order is the point of `after`: every click continues past its call,
# including the ones whose call raised.
#
# boundary.sngl is testdata/boundary_catches_called_raise.txtar's program: a
# boundary catching a raise from a called function, in a click and in an
# effect's @mount, and a call through a func value catching its own. fyne and
# gtk4 implement no boundary, so it runs on the interpreter and html only.
#
# return.sngl is testdata/error_handler_return.txtar's program: a `return` in
# a handler ends the handler and not the function it was inlined into.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none boundary.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none return.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

[!chromium] skip 'the JavaScript half needs a real Chromium'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html boundary.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html return.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required for cgo'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'
[!display] skip 'gtk4 runs its tests against a real GDK display (headless CI has none)'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func check(n int) {
    if n > 1 {
        error.raise("too big", "range")
    }
}

func scaled(n int) int {
    check(n)
    return n * 10
}

component main node {
    var caught = ""
    var after = ""

    func viaFunc() {
        check(5, @error(e) { caught = caught + "func:" + e.message + ";" })
        after = after + "f"
    }

    button #inHandler(text="Handler", @click {
        check(5, @error(e) { caught = caught + e.message + "/" + e.kind + ";" })
        after = after + "h"
    })
    button #inFunc(text="Func", @click { viaFunc() })
    button #deep(text="Deep", @click {
        scaled(7, @error(e) { caught = caught + "deep:" + e.message + ";" })
        after = after + "d"
    })
    button #fine(text="Fine", @click {
        check(1, @error(e) { caught = caught + "never;" })
        after = after + "ok"
    })
    text(value="{caught}|{after}")
}

func testEachCallCatchesItsOwnRaise(t Test, c main) {
    c.inHandler.click()
    c.inFunc.click()
    c.deep.click()
    c.fine.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "too big/range;func:too big;deep:too big;")
    t.assert(c.after == "hfdok")
}

window {
    main
}
-- boundary.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func risky(n int) int {
    if n > 1 {
        error.raise("too big", "range")
    }
    return n * 10
}

component main node {
    var caught = ""
    var after = ""
    boundary(@error(e) { caught = caught + e.message + ";" }) {
        effect(@mount { risky(3) })
        button #stmt(text="Stmt", @click {
            risky(5)
            after = after + "s"
        })
    }
    button #lam(text="Lambda", @click {
        var f = func() { error.raise("lam", "") }
        f(@error(e) { caught = caught + "lam:" + e.message + ";" })
        after = after + "l"
    })
    text(value="{caught}|{after}")
}

func testBoundaryAndLambdaCatch(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.caught == "too big;")
    c.stmt.click()
    c.lam.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "too big;too big;lam:lam;")
    t.assert(c.after == "sl")
}

window {
    main
}
-- return.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func check(n int) {
    if n > 1 {
        error.raise("too big", "range")
    }
}

component main node {
    var caught = ""
    var after = ""

    func viaCall() {
        check(5, @error(e) {
            caught = caught + "c"
            if caught != "" {
                return
            }
            caught = "unreached"
        })
        after = after + "c"
    }

    func viaRaise() {
        error.raise("r", "", @error(e) {
            caught = caught + "r"
            return
        })
        after = after + "r"
    }

    button #call(text="Call", @click { viaCall() })
    button #raise(text="Raise", @click { viaRaise() })
}

func testReturnEndsOnlyTheHandler(t Test, c main) {
    c.call.click()
    c.raise.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "cr")
    t.assert(c.after == "cr")
}

window {
    main
}
